feedback: Decision: approve. The candidate changes one field from the best raced design (iteration 6, score 85.60): controller.kd from 0.30 to 0.20. Geometry, kp 4.0, ki 0.05, base_speed 1.0, sensor weights and line_loss search_left are unchanged, so the race isolates derivative damping. The evidence supports the test. Iteration 1 showed kd 0.30 raised steering_oscillation above the 0.15 guide (0.154 on s-bend, 0.158 on slalom), and iteration 6 shows oval oscillation at 0.1917, still above it. Oval max_error (0.0623 in iteration 6) is still just over the 0.06 m limit, and iteration 2 showed kd 0.15 cut progress on s-bend and slalom, so the expected cost of lowering kd is a small progress drop. That is why the watch value is the iteration 6 oval progress of 0.3425. Approval is a bet on a one-field test with spare runs, not a claim that this candidate beats iteration 6. Read the race as follows. (a) If oval steering_oscillation falls below 0.15 and oval max_error falls below 0.06 with progress at or above about 0.32, keep kd 0.20. (b) If oval progress falls well below 0.3425 while oscillation stays high, return kd to 0.30, since damping is not the oval's limit. (c) If s-bend and slalom still show one line-loss event each, which every recovery direction and speed have left unchanged (iterations 0 to 6), stop tuning the controller on those tracks and change the sensor layout: a fifth forward sensor at y 0.06 or a wider spread at fixed weights.
requested_changes: Keep kd at 0.20 if the race shows oval steering_oscillation below 0.15 and oval progress at or above about 0.32. Evidence: oval oscillation was 0.1917 at kd 0.30 (iteration 6), and iteration 1 showed kd 0.30 pushed oscillation above 0.15.

If oval progress falls well below 0.3425 at kd 0.20, return kd to 0.30 and leave the controller alone. Evidence: iteration 6 oval progress was 0.3425 at kd 0.30, and iteration 2 showed lower kd (0.15) cut s-bend and slalom progress.

If s-bend or slalom still show line_loss_events of 1 after this race, test a sensor layout change with speed, kp, kd and line_loss held fixed: add a fifth forward sensor at y 0.06, or widen the spread to ±0.08 m. Evidence: line_loss stayed at 1 on those tracks under last_direction (iterations 0 to 3), search_right (iteration 4), and search_left (iterations 5 and 6).
